items.title: EU investigates Booking.com over fraud risks
items.snippet: The European Commission has opened an investigation into Booking.com to assess its handling of fraudulent accommodation listings and phishing scams. The inquiry will examine whether the online booking platform complies with the European Union ’s Digital Services Act (DSA). The Commission announced the investigation on Wednesday, following a preliminary assessment.

items.title: Southwest Airlines Slashes 2026 Profit Guidance on Higher Fuel Bills
items.snippet: Skift Take: Southwest is the latest airline to slash its profit outlook for the year as surging fuel costs bite into record revenues. Southwest Airlines is cutting its profit outlook for 2026 as it anticipates paying as much as $4.55 a gallon for jet fuel in the fourth quarter. The carrier now expects adjusted earnings per share this year to range between $2.60 and $2.85.

items.title: Accor Signs 120-Key Novotel Hotel in Himachal Pradesh
items.snippet: Novotel Solan Kumarhatti is scheduled to open in 2031, marking Accor’s entry into the state and targeting leisure, weddings and MICE demand. Accor has signed a 120-key Novotel hotel in Kumarhatti, Himachal Pradesh, marking the hospitality group’s entry into the state as it expands its presence in emerging leisure destinations across India.

items.title: IHCL Raises FY27 Revenue Guidance to 15-17% as Q2 Revenue Rises 21%
items.snippet: The hospitality group reports INR 2,566 crore consolidated revenue and expands its portfolio to 670 hotels, with 280 properties in the pipeline. The Indian Hotels Company Ltd. (IHCL) has raised its consolidated revenue growth guidance for FY2027 to 15-17% from 12-14%, following a record second quarter in which revenue rose 21% year-on-year to INR 2,566 crore.

items.title: Hotel Covington Increases Average Check Size by 15% With Canary's F&B Mobile Ordering
items.snippet: Hotel Covington deployed Canary Technologies' F&B mobile ordering, AI messaging, and dynamic upsells, achieving a 15% increase in average check size at its 114-room Kentucky property.

items.title: Accor signs Novotel Solan Kumarhatti, marking its entry into Himachal Pradesh
items.snippet: Accor has signed Novotel Solan Kumarhatti, marking the hospitality group’s entry into Himachal Pradesh. Scheduled to open in 2031, the 120-key hotel will strengthen Accor’s presence in India’s emerging leisure destinations, with a focus on wellness, family travel, destination weddings and MICE. Located along the Kalka–Shimla Highway, the property will offer convenient access to Kasauli, Chail and Shimla.

items.title: Royal Caribbean offers Mastercard savings on select cruises
items.snippet: Royal Caribbean has announced a Mastercard promotion offering savings of up to 10% on select sailings aboard Quantum, Spectrum, Navigator and Voyager of the Seas. The offer applies to eligible bookings made between October 19, 2026, and September 30, 2027, giving travellers another opportunity to plan a cruise holiday while accessing promotional fares.

items.title: Axis Bank, Visa launch ‘Dil Se Open’ Festive Campaign
items.snippet: Axis Bank, in partnership with Visa, has launched its festive campaign, ‘Dil Se Open Celebrations 2026’, under the tagline ‘Iss festive season, har khushi ko banao badi’. Featuring actor Shahid Kapoor, the campaign celebrates the desire to make festive moments more special through imaginative storytelling and rewards on eligible Axis Bank Visa Credit Cards.

items.title: IHCL announces record Q2 FY27 results, upgrades revenue guidance by 300 basis points
items.snippet: In its 18th consecutive record quarter, the company reported a 21 percent rise in revenue to Rs 2,566 crore, while hotel-segment revenue increased 24 percent. EBITDA grew 21 percent to Rs 788 crore and profit after tax rose 23 percent to Rs 349 crore, with a diversified brandscape expanding the portfolio to 670 hotels, stated a release.
